avgvisib.criterion: share of time with any part of the solar disk visible (as LOLA AVGVISIB)
avgvisib.note: Same criterion as LOLA (any part of the disk). Ours: 2026-2030 (5 years), 1 km grid, 72 azimuths, observer 2 m; LOLA AVGVISIB: 18.6-year average at 120 m. Differences include the shorter period, the coarser terrain and the observer height.

avgearth.criterion: share of time with any part of the Earth disk visible (as LOLA)
avgearth.note: Ours: 2026-2030, 1 km grid, 72 azimuths, observer 2 m; LOLA: 18.6-year average at 120 m. The web scores Earth by the disk centre, which is slightly stricter.
